ItemID: NA; Title: Lost and Found Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy, direct sound fits my taste, but other albums interest me more this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Young and the Hopeless; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am currently looking for heavier music rather than this pop-punk sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Ten Thousand Fists makes me eager to explore more Disturbed, especially its heavy riffs and melodic vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Death-Grip On Yesterday; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The mix of melody and aggression appeals to me, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heaviness fits, though I want something closer to my recent metal listening today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Deftones; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The atmospheric heaviness appeals to the side of my taste reflected in 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: See You On The Other Side Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves appeal, but I am less drawn to its electronic textures right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Melodic hooks alongside aggressive riffs make this especially appealing after my In Flames and Soilwork listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Used; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its more emo-focused sound is less suited to the riff-heavy music I want today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its combination of intense percussion, heavy riffs, and melody sounds like a strong fit.
